messages:
sam: Heads-up: PR #5128 is blocked by the e2e pipeline — job integration/e2e-smoke keeps failing on 'UI:checkout-flow' :frowning:
ci-bot: Build 7821 failed — https://ci.redwood.example/7821 (tests: integration/e2e-smoke)

Failed test snippet:
```
UI:checkout-flow › should complete payment flow
  Error: Timeout of 30000ms exceeded while waiting for selector "#payment-confirm"
    at Object.waitForSelector (test/helpers/wait.js:42:15)
```

kevin: @sam :eyes: I'll grab this in ~15m, might be flaky on CI headless timing. Any recent changes to checkout waits in the PR?
maria: @kevin I ran the branch locally in headed mode and it passes consistently. In CI when I reran once it passed, twice it failed. Seems nondeterministic — suspect network race on our mock payment gateway stub.
anya: Can we rerun the job for now to unblock the merge? If it's flaky we should mark the test flaky and add a ticket to root cause.
sam: I'd prefer not to shortcut unless we have an owner — PR is blocking a release branch. @maria do you want to add a short retry wrapper around the selector wait in this PR? Even a simple retry with 3 attempts should help.
maria: Pushed a small change: add retry to waitForSelector and extend timeout to 60s, plus comment to follow up with proper fix. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5128/files
ci-bot: Build 7822 queued by maria — starting run...
devops-bot: Note: integration/e2e-smoke runs on macos-11-latest workers which had a 5% failure spike last week, see infra incident #301.
kevin: Re-running locally in CI emulation mode (Xvfb) to try reproduce. If that passes, we can merge after a green build and @anya gives the final approval.
ci-bot: Build 7822 failed — same test timeout. Logs: "NetworkError: failed to fetch /mock-gateway/charge"

maria: OK that points to mock gateway instability. I'll add exponential backoff + mock gateway healthcheck before starting flow. Will push in a sec.
kevin: If you want me to, I can add a temporary `ci: flaky` annotation to the test to unblock until infra fixes the worker instability. Would prefer a short-lived skip though.
anya: Fine with temporary skip if you create a follow-up ticket and tag infra + QA. Please include exact failure log and link to PR.
sam: Sounds good. @kevin, can you add the skip and a ticket referencing infra #301 and QA #412? Then once CI is green we'll merge and remove the skip ASAP.
kevin: Done — added `@flaky` tag and created issue #529 (link: https://go.redwood/issue/529) with description and logs. Re-run build.
ci-bot: Build 7823 succeeded — all tests green.

anya: Approved. :white_check_mark:
sam: Merged. Thanks everyone. Please follow up on #529 and remove `@flaky` once infra/qa confirm fix.
